scraped.scraped_description: Prolific helps AI developers, researchers, and organizations easily access the highest-quality human data. Sign up for free.

name: Prolific
tagline: Easily collect high-quality data from real people
countries_deployed: Multiple (70+ countries mentioned for Collective Intelligence Project)
dependency_risks: Platform dependency - users rely on Prolific's infrastructure for participant recruitment; potential service disruption risks; data privacy compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions
news_articles: Prolific raises Series A funding for research data platform
How Prolific is changing academic research recruitment
Ai2 reduced human data collection from weeks to hours with Prolific, building state-of-the-art multimodal AI models faster
Columbia University researchers used Prolific to explore how people make choices when fighting climate change
The Collective Intelligence Project used Prolific to bring voices from 70+ countries into AI governance
academic_citations: Prolific has been cited in numerous peer-reviewed studies on crowdsourcing and research methodology
Used extensively in psychology, behavioral economics, and AI safety research

policy_outcomes.description: Collective Intelligence Project used Prolific to bring voices from 70+ countries into the heart of AI governance
Ai2 reduced human data collection from weeks to hours with Prolific, accelerating factuality testing by 10x for state-of-the-art multimodal AI models
Columbia University researchers used Prolific to explore how people make choices when fighting climate change, redefining environmental decision-making

outcome_methodology: Prolific serves as a data collection infrastructure; outcomes depend on how client organizations use the platform for research and decision-making
published_performance_metrics: Prolific publishes data quality metrics and participant demographics on their platform; case studies available on website
documented_limitations: Participant pool may not be fully representative of global populations
Cost barriers may limit accessibility for some researchers
failure_modes: Platform outages could disrupt ongoing research studies
Data quality issues if participant vetting processes fail
Regulatory compliance failures across different jurisdictions
curation_criteria: Prolific uses automated and manual screening to verify participant quality; participants must pass attention checks and maintain quality standards
contributor_governance: Participant-driven platform with built-in quality control mechanisms; researchers can set custom screening criteria
disparity_tracking: Prolific tracks participant demographics including geographic location, age, education level; limited public reporting on equity metrics
legal_regulatory_issues: Subject to GDPR, CCPA, and other data privacy regulations; must comply with research ethics requirements across jurisdictions
ai_involvement: Prolific is used for AI training, evaluation, safety testing, and data annotation; the platform itself supports AI development workflows
